title: Zorro Ranch
content: Rancho de San Rafael, formerly known as Zorro Ranch, is a large private property located near Stanley, New Mexico, United States, about 30 miles southeast of Santa Fe. It was owned by the financier and child sex offender Jeffrey Epstein from the early 1990s until his death in 2019, then by the estate of Jeffrey Epstein during a sale of the property concluding in 2023, and is now owned by the family of politician Don Huffines.
